podcast.body: This 2001 album topped the charts and featured the deep cut "Takeover," a significant diss track aimed at Nas. The song notably "prominently sampled The Doors' bruising 60s rock jam '5-1' and interpolated the hook from David Bowie's thing," showcasing a blend of rock influences within hip hop. "Takeover, a deep cut from Jay's 2001 chart-topping album The Blueprint prominently sampled The Doors, bruising 60s rock jam 5-1, and interpolated the hook from David Bowie's thing."

podcast.body: This album marked a significant resurgence in Jay-Z's musical career, which had experienced a "small creative crisis" around 2000. The album's success and shift away from a strictly gangster rap sound were largely attributed to the production work of Kanye West. "Es casi posiblemente el protagonista del gran resurgir de Jay-Selt con The Blueprint."
